title: DELETE
description:
## DELETE
`UPDATE` has a counterpart: `DELETE`. DELETE lets you delete existing rows in a table. The syntax is:
```sql
DELETE FROM table_name
    WHERE condition;
```
Similar, right? And yet again, **WARNING:** If you forget the `WHERE` clause, it deletes EVERY row. That's bad.
---
## Assignment:
BWS found a whole slew of apps by one person using a fake country to bypass payment! Delete all rows from deployments where region is equal to 'chameritan'
setupCode: CREATE TABLE deployments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, app TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', region TEXT); INSERT INTO deployments (app, status, region) VALUES ('BWS-API', 'not-on-fire-anymore', 'us-east'), ('Lol', 'Vibe-Coded', 'chameritan'), ('Bread tracker', 'made with butter on rye', 'gm'), ('Byby resources', '2 TBs lol', 'chameritan');
runHarness: SELECT * FROM deployments ORDER BY id ASC;
expectedOutput:
id | app | status | region
1 | BWS-API | not-on-fire-anymore | us-east
3 | Bread tracker | made with butter on rye | gm
